title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: submit an Agent Builder agent to the Agent Store for admin approval
summary: The submission and approval flow, licensing qualifications and all six control surfaces are supported by Microsoft documentation. Two small citation corrections remain: another Microsoft page gives a different maker navigation route, and the sharing navigation relies on an uncited governance page.

claims.claim: The maker route is Microsoft 365 Copilot > All agents > agent > Edit > More > Submit to your org catalog.

claims.fix: Retain this route and add: 'Another Microsoft page gives the maker route as Plugins > Chat > Added > Manage all > agent > More options > Edit, followed by More > Submit to your org catalog.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/copilot-agent-store#create-and-publish-agent-builder-agents, whose steps were returned by Learn search.
